content.title: While Oilfield Firms Eye Venezuela Return, One is Already There Drilling Wells
content.summary: While big oilfield services companies including Halliburton and SLB await the green light to ramp back up in Venezuela, one of their rivals already has rigs running in the country.  Ensign Energy Services, with headquarters in Calgary, Alberta, and operations around the world, has had two rigs drilling in Venezuela since autumn, the latest in an on-again-off-again past several years there for the firm.  "We've stuck it out," Robert Geddes, president and chief operating officer, said in an interview.
